items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I see your friend it's been so long since I've seen him Robert Lewis is that his name? ... [INTERVIEWEE] that's right

ctx.x: no I never did no I was in England in 56 but I didn't get over and he was in Italy at the time touring he wasn't in Paris

I see your friend it's been so long since I've seen him Robert Lewis is that his name? Robert Lewis Robert Lewis yeah he sent him a soprano sax there that's right a year or so before he died he came through here and we had a nice little interview with him he took a few lessons from him
